Replay tile API, diagnostics, scratch sizing, and loop control for pcap-to-frag streaming.

# Purpose
This header defines the public interface for `fd_replay`, which replays packet data from a `pcap` file into a Tango fragment stream. It declares command-and-control signal values, diagnostic offsets in the `cnc` application region, and the scratch memory size and alignment rules for a replay tile. The file also declares the main entry points [`fd_replay_tile`](<#fd_replay_tile>), [`fd_replay_tile_loop`](<#fd_replay_tile_loop>), [`fd_replay_tile_scratch_align`](<#fd_replay_tile_scratch_align>), and [`fd_replay_tile_scratch_footprint`](<#fd_replay_tile_scratch_footprint>), which let callers start and manage the replay process. The declarations are enabled only when `FD_HAS_HOSTED` and `FD_HAS_X86` are true.
# Function Declarations (Public API)

---
- `fd_replay_tile_scratch_align`
- `fd_replay_tile_scratch_footprint`
- `fd_replay_tile`
- `fd_replay_tile_loop`
